meta.status: unverified proposed balance / no gameplay implemented
locked_concepts: Finite iron ore + later renewable income
Complete small AI skirmish as first milestone
meta.health_points: Integer max HP; changed by armor upgrade and veterancy
meta.weapon_stat_format: Base hit damage / firing interval seconds, range R in world units; actual final damage also uses weapon-type multiplier against target armor. Multiple projectiles are specified with ×N. Splash radius R is in world units.
meta.time: In-game construction seconds at 1x producer count and no economic/power penalties; gradual credit spending.
meta.unit_speed: World units per second at normal speed. Aircraft speed is flight world units per second.
meta.low_power: Halves production rate in baseline; energy doctrinal weapons have described additional penalties.
meta.veterancy: Rookie 1.0; Veteran +8% HP/+8% damage; Elite +15% HP/+15% damage. Veteran Crews grants Veteran only on newly built tanks.
meta.airfield: 2 ready pads per standard Airfield, 3 after exclusive Air Superiority upgrade; aircraft reload at field; cannot fire unlimited missiles away from field.
meta.naval: Naval units only appear if skirmish map contains reachable water and appropriate Naval Dock.
meta.caution: The damage numbers are not canon RA2/Zero Hour numbers and are not asserted balanced; tune only after playtests.
